# Investigation and Faith

## #0 — The complete form

### Complete aphorism

> **The approachable limit is the basis of investigation;  
> the absolute limit is the basis of faith;  
> the limit of investigation is the limit of determination;  
> the limit of faith is never to be determined.**

Frank G. Taylor's complete four-line formulation gives investigation and faith one contemplation object. Its compact movement can be encountered together, then unfolded through the acts of determining and entrusting which make the distinction exact.

The first pair names two bases from which a life proceeds. The second pair turns each activity back upon its limit. Investigation determines; faith continues without making the absolute condition into a final determination. Reading the pairs together keeps the act of inquiry and the act of entrusting within one life, while preserving the different work each performs.

## #1 — An approachable limit gives inquiry work

Investigation approaches something that can become more determinate. An omitted observation can be made, a claim examined, an instrument's conditions exposed, a frame revised. The resulting knowledge changes what can next be asked and done. Approach names this positive capacity to enter a question and make a difference within it.

An [enlarged account](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) can include body, language, memory, method and institution previously left unexamined. Those additions are actual gains: a previously omitted condition has become available to judgment. Yet the act of including it also occurs. Inquiry's next approachable task and the relation renewed by undertaking that task have different consequences. Calling both simply unknown would conceal what investigation can accomplish.

The [operation-specific question](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C04-Formal-Limit.md) concerns what these conditions permit and what their operation reproduces. A different formal container can permit a different determination; the revised operation still has laws under which its result holds. The investigation has a subject, conditions and an achieved result for which it can answer. Its exactness makes the next inquiry possible.

## #2 — Determining the condition renews the relation

An account can next investigate how its result became available. It can represent the observer's position, the rule of selection and the act that produced the first account. The second account then occurs through a present act of representation. Its greater content has not made that occurrence identical with the content it presents.

The [gap relocates as inquiry succeeds](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C05-Immutable-Gap.md). Capture the act that made the first account, and a further act performs the capture. This is recurrent non-coincidence, rather than one withheld fact awaiting discovery. A represented empty object can be exactly determined; a formal operation retains its specified rules; the native sign marks the unobjectifiable condition of determining. Their different offices survive the gain in knowledge. The aphorism's return to determination condenses that performed relation while retaining the distinctions on which it depends.

The absolute limit names the determining relation's non-exhaustion by another determination. It does not furnish a description of a hidden entity. What is said about a particular source, person or event still requires its own warrant. The limit keeps inquiry answerable for those determinations even as it prevents their completion from becoming possession of the whole condition of determining.

## #3 — Faith proceeds through the absolute limit

[Continuing through a finite account](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) already depends upon memory, language, witness, instruments, embodied competence and other people. Investigation can disclose and test those dependencies. Acting upon what it establishes remains an undertaking within them: examining a witness and deciding to rely on the testimony are related acts with different work to do.

Trust is already enacted dependence; knowledge is a finite articulation claiming fidelity; belief stabilises an orientation; faith consciously continues through the formal limitation. Faith's basis remains active in the use of a well-established account. The account can have been rigorously examined while its use still occurs in a lived relation which certification cannot manufacture. Faith consequently proceeds through the absolute limit, rather than occupying a shrinking residue of questions investigation has yet to solve.

The whole movement from reliance through position, articulated account, instituted order and inherited belonging into [renewed entrustment](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD-trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere.md#relational-offices) gives this continuation a temporal body. Someone already relies on language, witness and practice before the account can be examined. Examination makes that reliance explicit and settles a particular question; another undertaking then becomes possible. The settlement has done real work. Its future fulfilment remains to be lived by those who answer for it.

## #4 — A finite commitment remains answerable

A particular undertaking can have a named bearer, a stated obligation and conditions under which it is corrected, withdrawn or renewed. The last line's non-determination does not remove those particulars from inquiry. It returns their claim upon the source: no determinate undertaking can prescribe the absolute circumference of faith by making its own terms final.

A [symbolic account remains answerable](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md#trust-keeps-the-return-route-active) to the relation its form discloses. Articulation makes that relation inspectable without substituting the account for its source. Trust lets the account guide action while keeping source, reply and consequence able to alter what was undertaken. The effects of use then re-enter the conditions from which another account proceeds. Symbol, Account and Trust keep these four operations distinct through the same finite commitment.

A ground can withdraw, harm can occur and refusal can be justified. A commitment's finitude does not make it disposable at every difficulty; neither does its invocation of faith make its exercise immune to judgment. Investigation continues to distinguish what occurred, who bears the obligation and what the returned finding warrants. A mistaken result can be corrected under a fitting rule. An inadequate rule, source, permission or commission calls for return to the office able to revise it. An examined condition can also be retained with reasons. The later act inherits that judgment, including a justified refusal, while faith does not claim possession of the source through the account.

## #5→0 — Return to the inquiry and its source

### Source return

[Different formal-limit responses](../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy.md) make the inquiry more exact through their different objects, methods and warrants. Restricting permissible formation, establishing limits of derivability under stated hypotheses and performing the act which determines a condition have different consequences. The philosophical relation between investigation and conscious continuation remains present as each operation is examined under its own laws.

The reader can now return to the [complete block](#complete-aphorism) with both movements retained: investigate the determination and its conditions; receive the limit encountered in that very activity; carry an answerable commitment into what follows. [Determining more](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) renews the difference between the enlarged result and its determining act. [Continuing through that difference](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) carries the examined account into renewed entrustment with its source-return active. The [different psychic, institutional and technical settings](../maps/trust-faith-formal-limit.md) give this relation specific bearers, conditions and consequences. Each undertaking remains answerable at the scale where it acts.

The four lines remain one authorial form across these returns. Their independence gives them a place to be encountered whole; the developed inquiry remains available when the compact relation asks to be unfolded.

### Source standing

The complete wording and order are Taylor's ratified form. The surrounding explanation unfolds its existing investigation, determination, absolute-limit and faith relation; it supplies no additional authorial lines. The [protected lexical history](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/HISTORY-trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere.md) concerns distinct word-fields. The relation between prior reliance, examined account and renewed entrustment is Taylor's operational construction, with no shared descent claimed for investigation, limit and faith. The selected formal witnesses retain their particular hypotheses and methods alongside the independently argued determining-act relation.
